persona_and_theme.archetype: THE PERFORMANCE PRO / DARK METALLIC GAMER ELEGANCE
persona_and_theme.theme: Dark Modern (Black, Matte Charcoal, Slate Grey with subtle metallic accent glow)
persona_and_theme.aesthetic_notes: Premium bio-link platform competitor to guns.lol, bio.link, zyo.lol. Deep void blacks (#090a0f, #0d0f14), polished chrome/zinc borders (#27272a, #3f3f46), slate grey text hierarchy, high-contrast crisp white titles, zero cheap rainbow gradient slop.

key_components_and_sections.name: Full Page Loading Screen
key_components_and_sections.description: Smooth full-screen overlay with spinning metallic dual-ring loader, sleek logo pulse, and quick percentage/status tick before revealing the page.

key_components_and_sections.name: Top Pill Navbar
key_components_and_sections.description: Floating rounded-full glassmorphic container (backdrop-blur-xl bg-zinc-900/80 border border-white/10 px-6 py-3 z-50 fixed top-4). Left: Logo icon + 'swats.bio' wordmark. Center: Nav links (Home, Legal, Compare, Pricing). Far Right: Login / Register button or Dashboard button if logged in.

key_components_and_sections.name: Hero Section with 3D Headline & Claim Input
key_components_and_sections.description: Massive 3D effect gradient-extruded text reading 'THE #1 HOME FOR YOUR DIGITAL IDENTITY'. Subtext bio introduction. Interactive claim pill: 'swats.bio/' + input box + real-time auto-check availability badge + 'Claim' CTA button.

key_components_and_sections.name: Live Stats Counters
key_components_and_sections.description: 3 key metric blocks with smooth animated number counters: Bio Links Created (e.g., 148,920+), Total Profile Views (e.g., 12.4M+), Money Funded/Earned (e.g., $450,000+). Crisp glass cards with subtle top border highlight.

key_components_and_sections.name: Infinite Horizontal User Cards Carousel
key_components_and_sections.description: Two-row smooth infinite auto-scroll banner featuring top user cards with high-res avatars, display names, @usernames, verified badges, bio tags, and live view count badges.

key_components_and_sections.name: Features Showcase & Interactive Customizer
key_components_and_sections.description: Interactive 'Customize anything you want' section with live font switcher (allows user to select fonts like Unbounded, JetBrains Mono, Syne, Inter, Playfair and see live updates) and color theme toggles.

key_components_and_sections.name: Four Interactive Widget Preview Panels
key_components_and_sections.description: Dedicated grid showcasing 4 custom profile widgets: 1) Discord Widget ('swats.bio Community Server', 269 online, 1.3K members, Join Server CTA), 2) Music Player Widget (album artwork, song title, artist, audio visualizer, play/pause controls), 3) Roblox Profile Widget (avatar render, stats, game badges), 4) TikTok Widget (video card preview, follower count, direct link).

key_components_and_sections.name: Supported Platforms Showcase (25+ Platforms)
key_components_and_sections.description: Interactive platform grid with mini spinning disc visual and 25+ integrated platform icons (Valorant, Spotify, Twitch, YouTube, Roblox, TikTok, Discord, Steam, X/Twitter, Instagram, GitHub, Kick, Soundcloud, Pinterest, Snapchat, Reddit, Epic Games, Telegram, Apple Music, Netflix, Artstation, Behance, OnlyFans, LinkedIn, Paypal). Includes hover custom setting preview tooltips.

key_components_and_sections.name: Q&A Accordion Section
key_components_and_sections.description: FAQ section with category filter buttons on the right, title + icon on left, smooth Framer Motion height expansion, search bar filter, and crisp glass response cards.

key_components_and_sections.name: Footer Section
key_components_and_sections.description: High-impact dark footer with massive swats.bio wordmark, system status ping ('All systems operational'), navigation columns, legal links (Terms, Privacy, DMCA), and social media badges.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all code files are in standard React JavaScript (.js / .jsx) as configured in frontend/src.
Implement the initial spinning circle loading screen that dismisses after assets load or after a brief timeout.
Build the exact top pill navbar structure: Left logo icon + 'swats.bio', Center links (Home, Legal, Compare, Pricing), Right Login/Register or Dashboard button.
Implement the 3D hero headline with depth text-shadow, rounded pill claim input box 'swats.bio/[alias]', real-time availability indicator, and Claim CTA.
Build the 3 animated stat counters with smooth increment animations.
Create the 2-row infinite horizontal auto-scrolling marquee of user profile cards using Framer Motion or react-fast-marquee.
Build the 4 interactive widget preview cards: Discord (swats.bio Community, 269 online, 1.3K members, Join button), Music Player (working audio play/pause toggle, seek bar), Roblox, and TikTok.
Build the 25+ supported platforms section with interactive platform icons (including Valorant) and mini disc visualizer.
Ensure every single button, link, tab, input, and interactive card has a distinct `data-testid` attribute.
Use lucide-react or @react-icons for accurate platform icons.
